title: Normalized derived coefficient-system calculus data
statement: A derived coefficient-system calculus is the simultaneous derived tensor-Hom, fiber and quotient-scalar representative data with the stated K-flat evaluation and unit normalizations. Define its enriched scalar-adjunction map by base change of evaluation, the normalized tensor comparison and the scalar adjunction counit, followed by the closed transpose. The setting and constituent notions are those of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], [def-weil-size-convention], [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit], [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower], [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower], [lem-pc-kflat-resolution], [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], [def-pc-kflat-complex], [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], [lem-pur-rhom-global-sections], [lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction], [def-coef-hom-representative-evaluation], [def-coef-hom-zero-cycle-class], [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. The finite tensor-Hom fibers retain the closed symmetric monoidal coherence of [def-zl-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal-data]: the chosen tensor comparisons identify the intrinsic associator with reassociation of the signed total tensor on K-flat complexes (and likewise retain the native unit and symmetry constraints).
